Use of artificial intelligence

As required by §2(8) of the challenge rules, we describe how AI was used to build the solution.

  • Where AI helped

    A coding assistant (Claude Code) helped write and test the prototype and website code, analyse the open-source code of the dane.gov.pl portal, configure deployment and edit documentation.

  • What is the team's work

    The solution concept, the reference data scope, the campaign name and slogan, design decisions and verification of all results. We hold full rights to the solution.
